actions.tree: LineComment: // Empty buffer: offset 0 => 0 bytes available; any positive offset => still 0 [4038,4116]
LineComment: // Single-byte buffer: offset past the end clamps available to 0 [4322,4386]
LineComment: // 25-byte buffer: available = bufferLength - offset (clamped to 0 when offset >= length) [4624,4713]
LineComment: // Empty buffer: available is always 0 regardless of offset/length [5430,5496]
LineComment: // Single-byte buffer: available = min(length, bufferSize - offset), floored at 0 [5858,5939]
LineComment: // 25-byte buffer with various offset/length combinations [6570,6627]
LineComment: // Requested length exceeding actual buffer size is clamped to the remaining bytes [7334,7416]
LineComment: // Mark after reading the first byte; subsequent reads advance past the mark [10815,10891]
LineComment: // reset() repositions to the marked offset, allowing the same bytes to be re-read [10998,11080]
LineComment: // reset() can be called again to go back to the same mark a second time [11234,11306]
LineComment: // Reading from an empty stream returns END_OF_STREAM and leaves the buffer untouched [11593,11678]
LineComment: // A zero-length destination buffer causes read() to return 0 without consuming data [11911,11995]
LineComment: // Buffer larger than stream: all stream bytes are read; remaining buffer slots stay zero [12142,12231]
LineComment: // Buffer smaller than stream: first call fills the buffer, second call reads the remainder [12504,12595]
LineComment: // Empty stream always returns END_OF_STREAM regardless of the requested region [13040,13119]
LineComment: // len=0 always returns 0 without consuming any bytes [13727,13780]
LineComment: // Partial read of 2 bytes followed by a read that retrieves the single remaining byte [13933,14019]
LineComment: // Empty stream immediately signals end-of-stream [14493,14542]
LineComment: // Each successive call returns the next byte until the stream is exhausted [14666,14741]
LineComment: // Skip 1 leaves 2 bytes; next read returns the second byte [15089,15148]
LineComment: // skip(0) is a no-op: position and available count are unchanged [15479,15544]
LineComment: // Skip 2 leaves only the last byte readable [15731,15775]
LineComment: // Skipping exactly the stream length exhausts it without error [16010,16073]
LineComment: // Skipping more than available clamps to the end of the stream [16270,16333]
